neighbours.label: compass-direction adjectives (northern, southern, eastern, western, either case) modifying a region or place
fire: Heavy snow closed most roads in northern Sweden this week.
The festival draws visitors from all over southern Spain.
Farmers in the eastern provinces lost half their crop.
A long drought has emptied reservoirs across western Kenya.
Her family comes from a village in Northern Greece.
The railway finally reached the Southern coast in 1890.
Several tribes of the Eastern plains signed the treaty.
Trade grew quickly along the Western frontier after the war.
quiet: Heavy snow closed most roads in rural Sweden this week.
The festival draws visitors from all over coastal Spain.
Farmers in the mountain provinces lost half their crop.
A long drought has emptied reservoirs across inland Kenya.
Her family comes from a village in mainland Greece.
The railway finally reached the rocky coast in 1890.
Several tribes of the open plains signed the treaty.
Trade grew quickly along the river frontier after the war.

notes: Card: ' Northern' x13, ' northern' x8, ' southern' x4, ' Southern' x4, ' Western' x2. Probes 0.52-0.66 on all four directions; bare ' north' 0.39; rural/coastal 0.12-0.15.
